description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a well-known fast food chain specializing in Southern-style fried chicken, located along Fraser Highway in Abbotsford. The standalone retail building opened in late 2021 and offers takeout service. It is wheelchair accessible and has on-site washrooms, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through this busy commercial corridor.
